item.title: IonQ and CMC Microsystems Announce Collaboration to Expand Cloud Quantum Computing Access in Canada
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), the world’s leading quantum platform company, today announced a collaboration with Canadian Microelectronics Corporation, operating as CMC Microsystems. This collaboration integrates IonQ’s commercial trapped-ion quantum computing systems into Canada’s FABrIC Quantum Computing Sandbox (QCS).
